content: Advance M0130/W0135 by binding device-bound cache entries to a generation-scoped pipeline lifecycle. Require an existing validated device cache hit before acquisition, pin while a live pipeline binding exists, reject stale or duplicate generation bindings, and make release the prerequisite for device invalidation without claiming VkPipeline creation or warm-launch qualification.

The repository tracks one active pipeline binding per device-cache key. acquire_pipeline requires a resident device-bound hit and pins it under the repository mutex; a second acquire is rejected as pinned, a different generation is stale_generation, and release requires the matching generation before unpinning. Device invalidation continues to use the existing pinned admission guard and removes only after all bindings release.

Content revision c37d312 adds CacheStatus::stale_generation, generation-scoped acquire_pipeline/release_pipeline ownership, active binding tracking, and a guard preventing generic unpin from bypassing an active pipeline binding. README and W0135 record this as a host-independent cache lifecycle contract; actual VkPipeline objects remain outside the repository boundary.

The cache regression covers invalid and resident-miss acquisition, first and duplicate generation binding, stale acquisition and release, generic unpin rejection, invalidation while pinned, matching release, post-release invalidation, and status-string stability. nix develop .#vulkan --command ctest --preset vulkan --output-on-failure passed 88/88.
